notes: Hotfix 2: after 13880 fixed 'Ghi nhan loi' lighting up on unrelated admin pages, it still stayed active instead of 'Nhat ky loi' while actually viewing .../ghi-nhan-loi?view=log. Root cause: render() passes adminDashboard()/updateAdminView() a query-stripped routePath (cleanPath(routeKey)), so adminViolationMenuButtonsHtml/updateAdminView's active-state resolver could never see ?view=log or ?workflowStatus= and always defaulted violationEffectiveView to 'create'. violationsHtml() (the actual content) was never affected because it already reads currentRouteKey() (the live location, with query) directly instead of the passed-in path - that's why the page content correctly showed Nhat ky loi while the sidebar didn't. Both admin active-state call sites (assets/js/checklist/phf-checklist-app.js: adminViolationMenuButtonsHtml, updateAdminView) now resolve violationEffectiveView from currentRouteKey() instead of the stripped path argument, matching what the content already does. Manager sidebar (violationItem) already used currentRouteKey() and was unaffected. UI-only, no router/permission/workflow/KPI/backend change.
